Métricas HIS\n\n- **HIS_raw** $=1-|\\Delta|/|\\langle H\\rangle_{id}|$ (no invariante a $cI$)\n- **HIS_span** $=1-|\\Delta|/(\\lambda_{max}-\\lambda_{min})$ (métrica primaria)\n","metadata":{}},{"id":"371f222e-33a4-48ed-b230-498af9411d5a","cell_type":"code","source":"def his_raw(h_id, h_re):\n    d = abs(h_id)\n    return float(\"nan\") if d < EPS else 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / d\n\ndef his_span(h_id, h_re, span):\n    return 1.0 - abs(h_id - h_re) / span\n\ndef z_diff(a, sa, b, sb):\n    s = math.sqrt(sa**2 + sb**2)\n    return float(\"nan\") if (s < EPS or math.isnan(s)) else (a - b) / s\n\ndef group_stats(counts, op, n):\n    labels = op.paulis.to_labels()\n    coeffs = np.real(op.coeffs)\n    vals, cnt = [], []\n    for bs, c in counts.items():\n        s = bs.replace(\" \", \"\")[-n:].zfill(n)\n        e = 0.0\n        for lab, w in zip(labels, coeffs):\n            par = 0\n            for i, ch in enumerate(lab):\n                if ch != \"I\" and s[i] == \"1\":\n                    par ^= 1\n            e += w * (1 - 2 * par)\n        vals.append(e)\n        cnt.append(c)\n    cnt = np.array(cnt, float)\n    shots = max(cnt.sum(), 1.0)\n    return np.array(vals), cnt / shots, int(shots)\n\ndef estimate_energy(groups_counts, groups_ops, n):\n    h, var = 0.0, 0.0\n    for counts, op in zip(groups_counts, groups_ops):\n        v, p, shots = group_stats(counts, op, n)\n        m = float(p @ v)\n        h += m\n        var += float(p @ (v**2) - m**2) / max(shots, 1)\n    return h, math.sqrt(max(var, 0.0))\n\nprint(\"métricas OK\")\n","metadata":{"trusted":true,"execution":{"iopub.status.busy":"2026-10-13T12:23:07.755856Z","iopub.execute_input":"2026-10-13T12:23:07.756209Z","iopub.status.idle":"2026-10-13T12:23:07.770840Z","shell.execute_reply.started":"2026-10-13T12:23:07.756168Z","shell.execute_reply":"2026-10-13T12:23:07.769830Z"},"jupyter":{"source_hidden":true}},"outputs":[{"name":"stdout","text":"métricas OK\n","output_type":"stream"}],"execution_count":27},{"id":"60dc92a4-1d02-4da3-9424-80db7baf35cd","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## 3. 1)]\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t)\n\ndef random_pauli_H(n, seed):\n    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n    t = []\n    for l in \"XYZ\":\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l, i + 1: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.5))))\n        for i in range(n):\n            t.append((plabel(n, {i: l}), float(rng.normal(0, 0.4))))\n    return SparsePauliOp.from_list(t).simplify()\n\ndef build_prep(kind, n, idle=None, qaoa=(0.8, 0.4), hea=None):\n    qc = QuantumCircuit(n)\n    if kind == \"T1\":\n        g, b = qaoa\n        qc.h(range(n))\n        for i in range(n - 1):\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            qc.rz(-g, i + 1)\n            qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n        if idle:\n            idle(qc, \"cost\")\n        qc.rx(2 * b, range(n))\n        if idle:\n            idle(qc, \"mixer\")\n    else:\n        L = hea.shape[0]\n        for l in range(L):\n            for q in range(n):\n                qc.ry(float(hea[l, q, 0]), q)\n                qc.rz(float(hea[l, q, 1]), q)\n            for i in range(n - 1):\n                qc.cx(i, i + 1)\n            if idle:\n                idle(qc, f\"L{l}\")\n    return qc\n\ndef h_ideal(prep, H):\n    return float(np.real(Statevector.from_instruction(prep).expectation_value(H)))\n\ndef spectrum_span(H):\n    ev = np.linalg.eigvalsh(H.to_matrix())\n    return float(ev[-1] - ev[0]), float(ev[0]), float(ev[-1])\n\nN = N_LOGICAL\nbest, QAOA = None, (0.8, 0.4)\nH1 = maxcut_H(N)\nfor g in np.linspace(0.2, 1.2, T5: buscar seed con buen condicionamiento; N grande reduce |<H>|/span\nT5_SEED, T5_H, T5_HEA, t5_best = None, None, None, -1.0\n_candidates = []\nfor s in range(0, 300):\n    H = random_pauli_H(N, s)\n    span, _, _ = spectrum_span(H)\n    if span < EPS:\n        continue\n    hea = np.random.default_rng(s).uniform(0, 2 * np.pi, size=(3, N, 2))\n    hid = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T5\", N, hea=hea), hea=T5_HEA), T5_H)\n    span5_tmp, _, _ = spectrum_span(T5_H)\n\nspan1, _, _ = spectrum_span(H1)\nspan5 = span5_tmp\nhid1 = h_ideal(build_prep(\"T1\", N, qaoa=QAOA), H1)\nhid5 = hid5_tmp\n\ndef z_groups(H):\n    terms = list(zip(H.paulis.to_labels(), np.real(H.coeffs)))\n    buckets = {\"X\": [], \"Y\": [], \"Z\": [], \"I\": []}\n    for lab, w in terms:\n        letters = set(lab) - {\"I\"}\n        if not letters:\n            buckets[\"I\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Z\"}:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"X\"}:\n            buckets[\"X\"].append((lab, w))\n        elif letters <= {\"Y\"}:\n            buckets[\"Y\"].append((lab, w))\n        else:\n            buckets[\"Z\"].append((lab, w))\n    groups = []\n    for         items = buckets[\"I\"] or [(\"I\" * N, 0.0)]\n        op = SparsePauliOp.from_list([(lab, w) for lab, w in items])\n        groups.append(dict(basis=basis, op=op))\n    if not groups:\n        groups = [dict(basis=\"Z\", op=H)]\n    return groups\n\nHAM = {\n    \"T1\": dict(H=H1, h_id=hid1, span=span1, groups=z_groups(H1), kind=\"T1\", qaoa=QAOA, hea=None),\n    \"T5\": dict(H=T5_H, cal[\"t1\"], cal[\"t2\"], cal[\"ro\"], cal[\"g2q\"]\n    f = 0.40 * np.clip(1 - t2 / 150.0, 0, 1) + 0.15 * np.clip(1 - t1 / 100.0, 0, 1)\n    f += 0.25 * np.clip(ro / 0.05, 0, 1) + 0.20 * np.clip(g2 / 0.02, 0, 1)\n    return np.clip(f, 0, 1)\n\nclass SimDevice:\n    def __init__(self, M, seed, tls_frac, stale_flip, delta_good, delta_bad, time_drift=0.05, **_):\n        r = np.random.default_rng(seed)\n        self.M = M\n        self.edges = [(i, i + 1) for i in range(M - 1)]\n        self.p1 = 8e-4 * r.lognormal(0, 0.25, M)\n        self.p2 = 8e-3 * r.lognormal(0, 0.25, M)\n        self.ro = 0.015 * r.lognormal(0, 0.25, M)\n        self.t2b = 150 * r.lognormal(0, 0.10, M)\n        self.t1b = 105 * r.lognormal(0, 0.10, M)\n        self.sign = r.choice([-1, 1], M)\n        self.tls_cal = r.random(M) < tls_frac\n        self.tls_live = np.logical_xor(self.tls_cal, r.random(M) < stale_flip)\n        self.dg, self.db = delta_good, delta_bad\n        self.time_drift = time_drift\n        self.r = r\n        self._tick = 0\n\n    def snapshot(self, tls, jit):\n        j = (lambda: self.r.lognormal(0, jit, self.M)) if jit > 0 else (lambda: np.ones(self.M))\n        drift = 1.0 + self.time_drift * (self._tick / 20.0) * self.r.normal(0, 1, self.M)\n        self._tick += 1\n        return dict(\n            t2=np.where(tls, 40.0, self.t2b) * j() / np.clip(drift, 0.7, 1.4),\n            t1=np.where(tls, 55.0, self.t1b) * j() / np.clip(drift, 0.7, 1.4),\n            ro=self.ro * np.where(tls, 1.6, 1.0) * j(),\n            g2q=self.p2 * np.where(tls, 2.0, 1.0) * j(),\n            p1=self.p1 * np.where(tls, 2.0, 1.0),\n            delta=self.sign * np.where(tls, self.db, self.dg),\n        )\n\n    def noise_model(self, true):\n        nm = NoiseModel(basis_gates=[\"rz\", \"sx\", \"x\", \"cx\"])\n        for q in range(self.M):\n            nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(float(true[\"p1\"][q]), 1), [\"sx\", \"x\"], [q])\n            p = float(true[\"ro\"][q])\n            nm.add_readout_error(ReadoutError([[1 - p, p], [p, 1 - p]]), [q])\n        for a, b in self.edges:\n            pe = float(min(max(true[\"g2q\"][a], true[\"g2q\"][b]), 0.4))\n            for pair in ((a, b), (b, a)):\n                nm.add_quantum_error(depolarizing_error(pe, 2), [\"cx\"], list(pair))\n        return nm\n\ndef all_paths(adj, n):\n    paths = []\n    def dfs(p):\n        if len(p) == n:\n            paths.append(list(p))\n            return\n        for v in adj[p[-1]]:\n            if v not in p:\n                dfs(p + [v])\n    for s in list(adj.keys()):\n        dfs([s])\n    return paths\n\ndef score_path(path, fr, edge_err):\n    h = float(np.mean([1 - fr[q] for q in path]))\n    es = [edge_err.get(frozenset((a, b)), 0.01) for a, b in zip(path[:-1], path[1:])]\n    return h - 8.0 * (float(np.mean(es)) if es else 0.0)\n\nbackend = None\nsim_backend = None\ndevice = None\ncal_fr = None\nlive_fr = None\nEDGE_ERR device.snapshot(device.tls_live, jit=0.05)\n    cal_fr = per_qubit_friction(cal)\n    live_fr = per_qubit_friction(live)\n    EDGE_ERR = {frozenset(e): float(max(cal[\"g2q\"][e[0]], cal[\"g2q\"][e[1]])) for e in device.edges}\n    EDGES_HW = list(device.edges)\n    sim_backend = AerSimulator(\n        noise_model=device.noise_model(live),\n        coupling_map=CouplingMap(EDGES_HW),\n        basis_gates=[\"rz\", \"sx\", \"x\", \"cx\"],\n    )\n    print(\"SimDevice M=%d | fr_cal mean=%.3f max=%.3f | fr_live mean=%.3f max=%.3f\" % (\n        M_PHYS, cal_fr.mean(), cal_fr.max(), live_fr.mean(), live_fr.max()))\nelse:\n    from qiskit_ibm_runtime import QiskitRuntimeService\n    tok = os.environ.get(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\") or os.environ.get(\"QISKIT_IBM_TOKEN\")\n    if not tok:\n        try:\n            from kaggle_secrets import UserSecretsClient\n            tok = UserSecretsClient().get_secret(\"IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            raise RuntimeError(\"Falta IBM_QUANTUM_TOKEN\") from e\n    try:\n        svc = QiskitRuntimeService(channel=\"ibm_cloud\", token=tok.strip())\n    except Exception:\n        svc = QiskitRuntimeService(token=tok.strip())\n    backend = svc.backend(BACKEND_NAME)\n    M_PHYS = backend.num_qubits\n    props = backend.properties()\n    n_probe = min(M_PHYS, 80)\n    t1 = np.array([(props.t1(q) or 100e-6) for q in range(n_probe)]) * 1e6\n    t2 = np.array([(props.t2(q) or 80e-6) for q in range(n_probe)]) * 1e6\n    ro = np.array([(props.readout_error(q) or 0.03) for q in range(n_probe)])\n    if n_probe < M_PHYS:\n        t1 = np.pad(t1, (0, M_PHYS - n_probe), constant_values=100.0)\n        t2 = np.pad(t2, (0, M_PHYS - n_probe), constant_values=80.0)\n        ro = np.pad(ro, (0, M_PHYS - n_probe), constant_values=0.03)\n    g2 = np.full(M_PHYS, 0.01)\n    cal = dict(t1=t1, t2=t2, ro=ro, g2q=g2)\n    cal_fr =
